chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
“The reward for a believer, when his child dies, is Paradise, whether he shows patience or does not show patience.”

key_terms.الْجَنَّةُ: Paradise, the eternal abode of divine reward
key_terms.صَبَرَ: he was patient and endured the calamity

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for a believer whose child dies?
ai.summary: This hadith states that when a believer loses a child, the reward appointed for that calamity is Paradise. It highlights the immense divine recompense connected to such a painful loss and points to Allah’s mercy toward the believer in the Hereafter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.518 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The reward for a believer whose child dies is Paradise, whether they exhibit patience or not”.
